'''Kalmic''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Admiral/Legends|admiral]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] stationed on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] in [[3640 BBY]], when he was [[Death/Legends|killed]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Kalmic appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as a Champion boss on Corellia. He is not directly involved in any quests, but can be killed for loot and as part of the achievement. This article assumes 100% game completion, which means he was killed.<ref name="TOR" />
